migrations.name: page_artifacts
migrations.sql:
-- Human-authored static HTML snapshots. Source remains immutable in workspace
-- content-addressed attachment storage; every historical revision pins its blob.
CREATE TABLE page_artifacts (
 page_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES pages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 head_rev INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(head_rev > 0)
);
CREATE TABLE page_artifact_revisions (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 page_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision > 0),
 sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(sha256)=64),
 author_user_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 mutation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 request_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
 restored_from INTEGER,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(page_id,revision),
 UNIQUE(page_id,mutation_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_page_artifact_blobs ON page_artifact_revisions(sha256);
CREATE INDEX idx_page_artifact_authors ON page_artifact_revisions(author_user_id);
-- Enforce the type boundary even when a concurrent legacy writer has already
-- passed its application-level checks. A failed transaction leaves both intact.
CREATE TRIGGER page_artifact_empty_page BEFORE INSERT ON page_artifacts
WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pages WHERE id=NEW.page_id AND owner_user_id IS NOT NULL AND owner_crew_id IS NULL)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM page_panels WHERE page_id=NEW.page_id)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM page_project_drafts WHERE page_id=NEW.page_id)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM page_project_live WHERE page_id=NEW.page_id)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'artifact requires an empty human-owned page'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER page_artifact_no_panels BEFORE INSERT ON page_panels
WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM page_artifacts WHERE page_id=NEW.page_id)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'artifact pages cannot contain panels'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER page_artifact_no_project BEFORE INSERT ON page_project_drafts
WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM page_artifacts WHERE page_id=NEW.page_id)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'artifact pages cannot contain applications'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER page_artifact_human_owner BEFORE UPDATE OF owner_user_id,owner_crew_id ON pages
WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM page_artifacts WHERE page_id=NEW.id) AND (NEW.owner_user_id IS NULL OR NEW.owner_crew_id IS NOT NULL)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'artifact owner must be human'); END;

migrations.name: page_artifact_comments
migrations.sql:
-- Private human discussions stay bound to the exact immutable source revision.
CREATE TABLE page_artifact_threads (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 page_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
 anchor_json TEXT NOT NULL,
 status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK(status IN ('open','resolved')),
 version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(version > 0),
 created_by_user_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 resolved_by_user_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 resolved_at TEXT,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 FOREIGN KEY(page_id,revision) REFERENCES page_artifact_revisions(page_id,revision) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
CREATE INDEX idx_page_artifact_threads_revision ON page_artifact_threads(page_id,revision);
CREATE INDEX idx_page_artifact_threads_revision_number ON page_artifact_threads(revision,page_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_page_artifact_threads_author ON page_artifact_threads(created_by_user_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_page_artifact_threads_resolver ON page_artifact_threads(resolved_by_user_id);
CREATE TABLE page_artifact_comments (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 thread_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES page_artifact_threads(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 thread_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(thread_version > 0),
 body TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(body)>0),
 author_user_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(thread_id,thread_version)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_page_artifact_comments_author ON page_artifact_comments(author_user_id);
-- These receipts are also the durable mutation audit: identity, operation and
-- result version, without copying private comment bodies into workspace events.
CREATE TABLE page_artifact_comment_mutations (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 page_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 thread_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES page_artifact_threads(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 comment_id TEXT REFERENCES page_artifact_comments(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 mutation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 request_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
 actor_user_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 operation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(operation IN ('create','reply','resolve','reopen')),
 result_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(page_id,mutation_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_page_artifact_comment_mutations_thread ON page_artifact_comment_mutations(thread_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_page_artifact_comment_mutations_comment ON page_artifact_comment_mutations(comment_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_page_artifact_comment_mutations_actor ON page_artifact_comment_mutations(actor_user_id);

migrations.sql:
-- Retry identities survive source retention. No revision FK: a receipt may
-- identify a revision whose unpinned source has expired.
CREATE TABLE page_artifact_mutation_receipts (
 page_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 mutation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
 request_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
 author_user_id TEXT,
 author_agent_id TEXT,
 author_run_id TEXT,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 restored_from INTEGER,
 PRIMARY KEY(page_id,mutation_id)
);
INSERT INTO page_artifact_mutation_receipts SELECT page_id,mutation_id,revision,request_digest,author_user_id,author_agent_id,author_run_id,created_at,restored_from FROM page_artifact_revisions;
CREATE INDEX idx_artifact_mutation_receipt_rate ON page_artifact_mutation_receipts(page_id,created_at);

migrations.sql:
-- Copies are new private identities. This durable receipt is audit/provenance,
-- not authority and not a pin on the source's retained revision.
CREATE TABLE page_artifact_copies (
 id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
 workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 human_user_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 source_page_id TEXT REFERENCES pages(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 source_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(source_revision>0),
 source_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(source_sha256)=64),
 target_page_id TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES pages(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 mutation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 request_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(workspace_id,human_user_id,mutation_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_page_artifact_copies_scope ON page_artifact_copies(workspace_id,created_at);
CREATE TRIGGER page_artifact_copy_scope BEFORE INSERT ON page_artifact_copies
WHEN (NEW.source_page_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pages WHERE id=NEW.source_page_id AND workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id))
 OR (NEW.target_page_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pages WHERE id=NEW.target_page_id AND workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM page_artifact_revisions WHERE page_id=NEW.source_page_id AND revision=NEW.source_revision AND sha256!=NEW.source_sha256)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM page_artifact_revisions WHERE page_id=NEW.target_page_id AND revision=1 AND (sha256!=NEW.source_sha256 OR author_user_id IS NOT NEW.human_user_id OR author_agent_id IS NOT NULL OR author_run_id IS NOT NULL))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'artifact copy requires matching source and human target'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER page_artifact_copy_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON page_artifact_copies
WHEN NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.workspace_id IS NOT OLD.workspace_id OR NEW.source_revision IS NOT OLD.source_revision OR NEW.source_sha256 IS NOT OLD.source_sha256 OR NEW.mutation_id IS NOT OLD.mutation_id OR NEW.request_digest IS NOT OLD.request_digest OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at
 OR (NEW.human_user_id IS NOT OLD.human_user_id AND NOT(NEW.human_user_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE id=OLD.human_user_id)))
 OR (NEW.source_page_id IS NOT OLD.source_page_id AND NOT(NEW.source_page_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pages WHERE id=OLD.source_page_id)))
 OR (NEW.target_page_id IS NOT OLD.target_page_id AND NOT(NEW.target_page_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pages WHERE id=OLD.target_page_id)))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'artifact copy provenance is immutable'); END;
CREATE INDEX idx_page_artifact_copies_human ON page_artifact_copies(human_user_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_page_artifact_copies_source ON page_artifact_copies(source_page_id);

migrations.name: artifact_revision_manifest
migrations.sql:
-- Existing revisions have no authoritative size metadata. NULL explicitly
-- denotes legacy content; reads may derive a manifest from verified bytes but
-- never pretend that it was recorded or silently mutate the old revision.
ALTER TABLE page_artifact_revisions ADD COLUMN manifest_json TEXT
 CHECK(manifest_json IS NULL OR (json_valid(manifest_json) AND length(manifest_json)<=2048));
CREATE TRIGGER artifact_revision_manifest_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF manifest_json ON page_artifact_revisions
WHEN NEW.manifest_json IS NOT OLD.manifest_json
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'artifact revision manifest is immutable'); END;
